title: To amend sections 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, 10, and 14 of Public Law No. 24-39, as amended by Public Law No. 24-46, to appropriate $4,949,800 in supplemental funding from the General Fund of the Federated States of Micronesia for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, to provide funding for the Operatin
text:
TWENTY-FOURTH CONGRESS OF THE FEDERATED STATES OF MICRONESIA
THIRD REGULAR SESSION, 2026 CONGRESSIONAL BILL NO. 24-111, C.D.1
P.C. NO. 24-222 PUBLIC LAW NO. 24-55
AN ACT
To amend sections 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, 10, and 14 of Public Law No. 24-39,
as amended by Public Law No. 24-46, to appropriate $4,949,800 in
supplemental funding from the General Fund of the Federated States of
Micronesia for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, to provide
funding for the Operating Expenses of the Executive Branch; Operating
Expenses of the Legislative Branch; Capital and Human Resource
Development; and Compact Infrastructure Sector Grant Projects; to
expand the permissible use of funds for a certain line item; to add a
new subsection for the Operating Expenses of the Office of the
Independent Prosecutor; to set the allottee of the funds for the Office
of the Independent Prosecutor; and for other purposes.
BE IT ENACTED BY THE CONGRESS OF THE FEDERATED STATES OF MICRONESIA:
